ko.title: PCE 대 CPI: 연준이 선호하는 물가 지수가 종종 다른 결과를 보여주는 이유

segments.src: As the Federal Reserve approaches its December policy meeting, one number gets more attention inside the central bank than almost any other: the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index.
segments.tr: 미국 연방준비제도(Fed)의 12월 정책 회의가 다가옴에 따라, 중앙은행 내부에서 다른 어떤 지표보다도 더 큰 주목을 받는 숫자가 있습니다. 바로 개인소비지출(PCE) 물가지수입니다.

segments.src: Most households know the Consumer Price Index (CPI) better.
segments.tr: 대부분의 가계는 소비자물가지수(CPI)를 더 잘 알고 있습니다.

segments.src: It drives the headlines, cost-of-living adjustments and everyday conversation about prices.
segments.tr: CPI는 뉴스 헤드라인, 생활비 조정, 물가에 대한 일상적인 대화를 주도합니다.

segments.src: Yet the Fed formally targets PCE inflation, and the two measures can point in different directions.
segments.tr: 하지만 연준은 공식적으로 PCE 물가상승률을 목표로 삼고 있으며, 이 두 지표는 서로 다른 방향을 가리킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This explainer covers what each index measures, where they differ, and why the gap matters when you read the data.
segments.tr: 이 해설서에서는 각 지수가 무엇을 측정하는지, 어디서 차이가 나는지, 그리고 데이터를 읽을 때 이 격차가 왜 중요한지를 다룹니다.

segments.src: ## Two Gauges, Two Agencies
segments.tr: ## 두 지수, 두 기관

segments.src: **CPI** is produced by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).
segments.tr: **CPI**는 노동통계청(BLS)에서 작성합니다.

segments.src: It tracks the average change in prices that urban consumers pay out of pocket for a fixed basket of goods and services.
segments.tr: 도시 소비자가 고정된 상품 및 서비스 바구니에 대해 직접 지출하는 가격의 평균 변화를 추적합니다.

segments.src: **PCE** is produced by the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) as part of the national income and product accounts.
segments.tr: **PCE**는 국민소득 및 생산 계정의 일부로서 경제분석국(BEA)에서 작성합니다.

segments.src: It measures price changes for the goods and services consumed by households.
segments.tr: 가계가 소비하는 상품과 서비스의 가격 변화를 측정합니다.

segments.src: That includes spending made on their behalf.
segments.tr: 여기에는 가계를 대신해 이루어진 지출도 포함됩니다.

segments.src: Both aim to answer the question "how fast are prices rising?"
segments.tr: 두 지수 모두 "물가가 얼마나 빠르게 상승하고 있는가?"라는 질문에 답하는 것을 목표로 합니다.

segments.src: But they start from different data and answer slightly different versions of the question.
segments.tr: 하지만 출발점 데이터가 다르고, 질문의 약간씩 다른 버전에 답을 제시합니다.

segments.src: ## Difference 1: Weights
segments.tr: ## 차이점 1: 가중치

segments.src: The most important difference is how much each category counts.
segments.tr: 가장 중요한 차이점은 각 범주가 차지하는 비중입니다.

segments.src: - **Housing.** Shelter makes up roughly a third of the overall CPI basket. In PCE its share is much smaller, often cited as around 15%. When rents and housing costs are the main driver of inflation, CPI tends to run hotter than PCE. When shelter cools, CPI can fall faster.
segments.tr: - **주거비.** 주거비는 전체 CPI 바구니의 약 3분의 1을 차지합니다. PCE에서 그 비중은 훨씬 작아서 흔히 15% 안팎으로 언급됩니다. 임대료와 주거비가 물가상승의 주요 원인일 때는 CPI가 PCE보다 더 높게 나타나는 경향이 있습니다. 주거비 상승세가 둔화되면 CPI가 더 빠르게 하락할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Health care.** PCE gives health care a larger weight. It counts spending by Medicare, Medicaid and employer-provided insurance, not only what consumers pay directly.
segments.tr: - **의료비.** PCE는 의료비에 더 큰 가중치를 둡니다. 소비자가 직접 지불하는 비용뿐만 아니라 메디케어, 메디케이드 및 고용주가 제공하는 보험의 지출까지 포함합니다.

segments.src: - **Other categories.** Items such as financial services and some services paid for by third parties have a bigger presence in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: - **기타 범주.** 금융 서비스 및 제3자가 지불하는 일부 서비스와 같은 항목은 CPI보다 PCE에서 더 큰 비중을 차지합니다.

segments.src: Because the weights differ, the same price moves can produce different headline numbers.
segments.tr: 가중치가 다르기 때문에 동일한 가격 변동이라도 헤드라인 수치가 다르게 나올 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Difference 2: Scope
segments.tr: ## 차이점 2: 범위

segments.src: CPI is built from out-of-pocket spending by urban households.
segments.tr: CPI는 도시 가계의 직접 지출을 바탕으로 구성됩니다.

segments.src: PCE covers a broader universe:
segments.tr: PCE는 더 광범위한 영역을 다룹니다:

segments.src: - Spending by all households, including rural ones
segments.tr: - 시골 지역을 포함한 모든 가계의 지출

segments.src: - Spending by nonprofit institutions serving households
segments.tr: - 가계에 봉사하는 비영리 단체의 지출

segments.src: - Costs paid by third parties, such as government health programs and employer-sponsored insurance
segments.tr: - 정부 의료 프로그램 및 고용주 지원 보험 등 제3자가 지불하는 비용

segments.src: This is why health care looks so different in the two indexes.
segments.tr: 이것이 의료비가 두 지수에서 매우 다르게 보이는 이유입니다.

segments.src: A hospital bill paid largely by an insurer shows up more fully in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: 대부분 보험사가 지불하는 병원비는 CPI보다 PCE에 더 완전히 반영됩니다.

segments.src: ## Difference 3: Methodology
segments.tr: ## 차이점 3: 산출 방식

segments.src: The two indexes also differ in how they are calculated.
segments.tr: 두 지수는 계산 방식에서도 차이가 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Weight updates.** CPI weights come mainly from the Consumer Expenditure Survey and are updated on a set schedule. PCE weights come from broader business and national accounts data and are updated continuously.
segments.tr: - **가중치 갱신.** CPI 가중치는 주로 소비자지출조사에서 산출되며 정해진 일정에 따라 갱신됩니다. PCE 가중치는 더 넓은 기업 및 국민계정 데이터에서 산출되며 지속적으로 갱신됩니다.

segments.src: - **Formula.** PCE uses a chained, Fisher-type formula that captures how consumers shift between goods when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE reflects that substitution faster. CPI has narrowed this gap over the years, but it still captures substitution less fully.
segments.tr: - **수식.** PCE는 상대 가격이 변할 때 소비자가 상품 간에 구매를 어떻게 전환하는지 포착하는 연쇄 피셔(Fisher) 공식을 사용합니다. 소고기가 비싸져서 쇼핑객이 닭고기를 더 많이 산다면 PCE는 이러한 대체 효과를 더 빠르게 반영합니다. CPI도 수년간 이 격차를 줄여왔지만, 여전히 대체 효과를 덜 완전하게 포착합니다.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is almost never revised after release, apart from seasonal factors. PCE can be revised several times as new source data arrive, sometimes for months or years.
segments.tr: - **수정.** CPI는 계절적 요인을 제외하면 발표 후 수정되는 경우가 거의 없습니다. PCE는 새로운 원천 데이터가 들어옴에 따라 몇 달 또는 몇 년 동안 여러 번 수정될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Together these differences have historically kept CPI inflation a few tenths of a percentage point above PCE inflation on average.
segments.tr: 이러한 차이점들이 합쳐져 역사적으로 CPI 물가상승률은 PCE 물가상승률보다 평균적으로 몇 십분의 일 퍼센트 포인트 높게 유지되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: The gap is not constant.
segments.tr: 이 격차는 일정한 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It can widen or narrow depending on what is driving prices.
segments.tr: 물가를 견인하는 요인에 따라 벌어지거나 줄어들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Prefers PCE
segments.tr: ## 연준이 PCE를 선호하는 이유

segments.src: The Fed adopted an explicit 2% inflation goal in 2012, measured by the PCE price index.
segments.tr: 연준은 2012년에 PCE 물가지수로 측정되는 명확한 2% 물가상승률 목표를 채택했습니다.

segments.src: Policymakers have given several reasons for preferring it:
segments.tr: 정책 입안자들은 이를 선호하는 몇 가지 이유를 밝혔습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Broader coverage.** It captures a wider range of consumer spending.
segments.tr: 1. **더 넓은 포괄 범위.** 더 광범위한 소비자 지출을 포착합니다.

segments.src: 2. **Better handling of substitution.** The formula adjusts as buying patterns change.
segments.tr: 2. **우수한 대체 효과 처리.** 구매 패턴 변화에 맞춰 수식이 조정됩니다.

segments.src: 3. **Revisability.** Historical data can be corrected as better information becomes available.
segments.tr: 3. **수정 가능성.** 더 나은 정보를 이용할 수 있게 됨에 따라 과거 데이터를 수정할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Officials also watch **core PCE**, which excludes food and energy.
segments.tr: 당국자들은 식품과 에너지를 제외한 **근원 PCE**도 주시합니다.

segments.src: These categories are volatile, and core readings are often seen as a cleaner guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 이러한 범주는 변동성이 크기 때문에 근원 수치가 기저 트렌드를 더 명확하게 보여주는 지표로 여겨지곤 합니다.

segments.src: Many analysts also follow narrower cuts, such as core services excluding housing.
segments.tr: 많은 분석가들은 주거비를 제외한 근원 서비스와 같이 더 세부적인 항목도 추적합니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Two Can Point in Different Directions
segments.tr: ## 두 지표가 서로 다른 방향을 가리킬 수 있는 이유

segments.src: Divergences usually come from a few sources:
segments.tr: 괴리는 보통 몇 가지 원인에서 발생합니다:

segments.src: - **A shelter-driven swing.** If rent and owners' equivalent rent move sharply, CPI reacts more because shelter has a larger weight.
segments.tr: - **주거비 중심의 변동.** 임대료와 등가임대료가 급격히 움직이면, 주거비 가중치가 더 큰 CPI가 더 민감하게 반응합니다.

segments.src: - **Health care and financial services.** A jump in medical prices or portfolio-management fees, which often follow stock-market levels, can lift PCE more than CPI.
segments.tr: - **의료비 및 금융 서비스.** 의료 가격이나 주식 시장 수준을 자주 따르는 포트폴리오 관리 수수료가 급등하면 CPI보다 PCE가 더 많이 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** An updated PCE estimate can shift the picture after the first release.
segments.tr: - **수정.** 갱신된 PCE 추정치는 첫 발표 이후 전반적인 양상을 바꾸어 놓을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Timing.** CPI is published first each month, and parts of it feed into PCE estimates. Markets often treat CPI and producer price data as a preview of PCE. Those previews are estimates, and the final PCE figure can differ.
segments.tr: - **시점.** CPI가 매월 먼저 발표되며, 그 일부 항목은 PCE 추정치 산출에 입력됩니다. 시장은 CPI와 생산자물가 데이터를 PCE의 미리보기로 다루는 경우가 많습니다. 이러한 미리보기는 추정치이며, 최종 PCE 수치는 다를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Data
segments.tr: ## 데이터를 읽는 방법

segments.src: A few habits help when the two measures disagree:
segments.tr: 두 지표가 일치하지 않을 때 유용한 몇 가지 습관이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Compare like with like.** Check whether you are looking at headline or core figures, and monthly or year-over-year changes.
segments.tr: - **동일한 조건끼리 비교하기.** 보고 있는 수치가 헤드라인 지수인지 근원 지수인지, 그리고 전월 대비 변화인지 전년 동기 대비 변화인지 확인하세요.

segments.src: - **Look at the drivers.** Find out which categories explain the gap before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: - **동인 파악하기.** 결론을 내리기 전에 어떤 범주가 격차를 설명하는지 찾아보세요.

segments.src: - **Watch the trend, not one release.** A single month can be distorted by one-off factors.
segments.tr: - **단일 발표가 아닌 추세를 관찰하기.** 단 한 달의 수치는 일회성 요인으로 인해 왜곡될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Remember the purpose.** CPI is widely used for inflation-linked adjustments, including Social Security cost-of-living increases. PCE guides monetary policy.
segments.tr: - **목적을 기억하기.** CPI는 사회보장제도 생활비 인상을 포함해 인플레이션 연계 조정에 널리 사용됩니다. PCE는 통화 정책의 지침이 됩니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for the December Meeting
segments.tr: ## 12월 회의에 가지는 의미

segments.src: Policymakers weigh many inputs, including employment, wage growth, inflation expectations and financial conditions.
segments.tr: 정책 입안자들은 고용, 임금 상승, 인플레이션 기대를 비롯해 금융 여건 등 다양한 요소를 종합적으로 고려합니다.

segments.src: PCE inflation, especially the core measure, is central to their assessment of whether prices are returning to the 2% goal.
segments.tr: PCE 물가상승률, 특히 근원 지표는 물가가 2% 목표로 돌아가고 있는지 평가하는 데 핵심적인 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: When CPI and PCE tell different stories, officials look past the headline numbers and examine the components behind them.
segments.tr: CPI와 PCE가 서로 다른 이야기를 할 때, 당국자들은 헤드라인 수치를 넘어 그 뒤에 있는 구성 요소들을 면밀히 살핍니다.

segments.src: For readers, the takeaway is that neither index is "right" and the other "wrong."
segments.tr: 독자 여러분이 기억해야 할 점은 두 지수 중 어느 것도 "맞고" 다른 것이 "틀린" 것이 아니라는 사실입니다.

segments.src: They measure related but distinct things.
segments.tr: 두 지수는 관련되어 있지만 서로 다른 대상을 측정합니다.

segments.src: Knowing how they differ helps you interpret each new release and understand why the Fed's reading of inflation may not match the figure in the morning headline.
segments.tr: 두 지수 간의 차이를 이해하면 새로운 발표 데이터를 해석하고, 연준이 파악하는 인플레이션 수치가 왜 아침 뉴스 헤드라인의 수치와 다를 수 있는지 이해하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.tr: 투자, 금융 또는 세무에 관한 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.tr: 여기에 설명된 수치와 가중치는 대략적인 값이며 시간이 지남에 따라 변합니다.

zh.title: PCE 与 CPI：为什么美联储最青睐的通胀指标往往讲述着不同的故事

segments.src: As the Federal Reserve approaches its December policy meeting, one number gets more attention inside the central bank than almost any other: the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index.
segments.tr: 随着美联储临近 12 月的政策会议，央行内部有一个数字比几乎任何其他数字都受到更多关注：个人消费支出 (PCE) 价格指数。

segments.src: Most households know the Consumer Price Index (CPI) better.
segments.tr: 大多数家庭对消费者价格指数 (CPI) 更为熟悉。

segments.src: It drives the headlines, cost-of-living adjustments and everyday conversation about prices.
segments.tr: 它主导着新闻头条、生活成本调整以及关于物价的日常对话。

segments.src: Yet the Fed formally targets PCE inflation, and the two measures can point in different directions.
segments.tr: 然而，美联储正式设定的目标是 PCE 通胀，而这两个指标有时会指向不同的方向。

segments.src: This explainer covers what each index measures, where they differ, and why the gap matters when you read the data.
segments.tr: 本篇解读将涵盖每个指数的衡量内容、它们的区别，以及为什么在阅读数据时这种差距很重要。

segments.src: ## Two Gauges, Two Agencies
segments.tr: ## 两个指标，两个机构

segments.src: **CPI** is produced by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).
segments.tr: **CPI** 由劳工统计局 (BLS) 发布。

segments.src: It tracks the average change in prices that urban consumers pay out of pocket for a fixed basket of goods and services.
segments.tr: 它追踪城市消费者为一篮子固定商品和服务自掏腰包支付的平均价格变化。

segments.src: **PCE** is produced by the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) as part of the national income and product accounts.
segments.tr: **PCE** 由经济分析局 (BEA) 作为国民收入和产品账户的一部分发布。

segments.src: It measures price changes for the goods and services consumed by households.
segments.tr: 它衡量家庭消费的商品和服务的价格变化。

segments.src: That includes spending made on their behalf.
segments.tr: 这包括以家庭名义进行的支出。

segments.src: Both aim to answer the question "how fast are prices rising?"
segments.tr: 两者都旨在回答“物价上涨速度有多快？”这一问题。

segments.src: But they start from different data and answer slightly different versions of the question.
segments.tr: 但它们基于不同的数据，并回答了该问题的不同版本。

segments.src: ## Difference 1: Weights
segments.tr: ## 差异 1：权重

segments.src: The most important difference is how much each category counts.
segments.tr: 最重要的区别在于每个类别所占的比重。

segments.src: - **Housing.** Shelter makes up roughly a third of the overall CPI basket. In PCE its share is much smaller, often cited as around 15%. When rents and housing costs are the main driver of inflation, CPI tends to run hotter than PCE. When shelter cools, CPI can fall faster.
segments.tr: - **住房。** 住房成本约占 CPI 总篮子的三分之一。在 PCE 中，其份额要小得多，通常被引用为 15% 左右。当租金和住房成本成为通胀的主要驱动因素时，CPI 的涨幅往往高于 PCE。当住房成本降温时，CPI 的下降速度可能更快。

segments.src: - **Health care.** PCE gives health care a larger weight. It counts spending by Medicare, Medicaid and employer-provided insurance, not only what consumers pay directly.
segments.tr: - **医疗保健。** PCE 给医疗保健分配了更大的权重。它计算的是医疗保险 (Medicare)、医疗补助 (Medicaid) 和雇主提供的保险所支付的费用，而不仅仅是消费者直接支付的费用。

segments.src: - **Other categories.** Items such as financial services and some services paid for by third parties have a bigger presence in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: - **其他类别。** 金融服务和一些由第三方支付的服务等项目在 PCE 中的占比高于 CPI。

segments.src: Because the weights differ, the same price moves can produce different headline numbers.
segments.tr: 由于权重不同，相同的价格变动可能会产生不同的总体数据。

segments.src: ## Difference 2: Scope
segments.tr: ## 差异 2：范围

segments.src: CPI is built from out-of-pocket spending by urban households.
segments.tr: CPI 是基于城市家庭的自掏腰包支出构建的。

segments.src: PCE covers a broader universe:
segments.tr: PCE 涵盖的范围更广：

segments.src: - Spending by all households, including rural ones
segments.tr: - 所有家庭的支出，包括农村家庭

segments.src: - Spending by nonprofit institutions serving households
segments.tr: - 服务于家庭的非营利机构的支出

segments.src: - Costs paid by third parties, such as government health programs and employer-sponsored insurance
segments.tr: - 由第三方支付的成本，例如政府医疗计划和雇主赞助的保险

segments.src: This is why health care looks so different in the two indexes.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么医疗保健在两个指数中看起来如此不同。

segments.src: A hospital bill paid largely by an insurer shows up more fully in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: 主要由保险公司支付的医院账单在 PCE 中的体现比在 CPI 中更全面。

segments.src: ## Difference 3: Methodology
segments.tr: ## 差异 3：方法论

segments.src: The two indexes also differ in how they are calculated.
segments.tr: 这两个指数的计算方式也不同。

segments.src: - **Weight updates.** CPI weights come mainly from the Consumer Expenditure Survey and are updated on a set schedule. PCE weights come from broader business and national accounts data and are updated continuously.
segments.tr: - **权重更新。** CPI 权重主要来自消费者支出调查，并按既定时间表更新。PCE 权重来自更广泛的商业和国民账户数据，并持续更新。

segments.src: - **Formula.** PCE uses a chained, Fisher-type formula that captures how consumers shift between goods when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE reflects that substitution faster. CPI has narrowed this gap over the years, but it still captures substitution less fully.
segments.tr: - **公式。** PCE 使用连锁的费雪 (Fisher) 类型公式，该公式捕捉了当相对价格变化时消费者如何在商品之间进行转换。如果牛肉变贵了，购物者购买更多的鸡肉，PCE 能更快地反映这种替代效应。CPI 多年来缩小了这一差距，但它对替代效应的捕捉仍不够全面。

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is almost never revised after release, apart from seasonal factors. PCE can be revised several times as new source data arrive, sometimes for months or years.
segments.tr: - **修正。** 除了季节性因素外，CPI 发布后几乎从不修正。PCE 可能会随着新的源数据到来而被多次修正，有时会持续数月或数年。

segments.src: Together these differences have historically kept CPI inflation a few tenths of a percentage point above PCE inflation on average.
segments.tr: 这些差异加在一起，历史上使 CPI 通胀率平均比 PCE 通胀率高出零点几个百分点。

segments.src: The gap is not constant.
segments.tr: 这种差距并非恒定。

segments.src: It can widen or narrow depending on what is driving prices.
segments.tr: 它会根据推动价格的因素而扩大或缩小。

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Prefers PCE
segments.tr: ## 为什么美联储更偏好 PCE

segments.src: The Fed adopted an explicit 2% inflation goal in 2012, measured by the PCE price index.
segments.tr: 美联储在 2012 年采用了明确的 2% 通胀目标，该目标由 PCE 价格指数衡量。

segments.src: Policymakers have given several reasons for preferring it:
segments.tr: 政策制定者给出了偏好它的几个原因：

segments.src: 1. **Broader coverage.** It captures a wider range of consumer spending.
segments.tr: 1. **覆盖范围更广。** 它捕捉了更广泛的消费者支出。

segments.src: 2. **Better handling of substitution.** The formula adjusts as buying patterns change.
segments.tr: 2. **更好地处理替代效应。** 当购买模式发生变化时，公式会自动调整。

segments.src: 3. **Revisability.** Historical data can be corrected as better information becomes available.
segments.tr: 3. **可修正性。** 随着更好的信息可用，历史数据可以得到修正。

segments.src: Officials also watch **core PCE**, which excludes food and energy.
segments.tr: 官员们还关注**核心 PCE**，它排除了食品和能源。

segments.src: These categories are volatile, and core readings are often seen as a cleaner guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 这些类别波动较大，核心读数通常被视为对潜在趋势更清晰的指引。

segments.src: Many analysts also follow narrower cuts, such as core services excluding housing.
segments.tr: 许多分析师还关注更细分的指标，例如剔除住房后的核心服务通胀。

segments.src: ## Why the Two Can Point in Different Directions
segments.tr: ## 为什么两者会指向不同的方向

segments.src: Divergences usually come from a few sources:
segments.tr: 分歧通常来自几个来源：

segments.src: - **A shelter-driven swing.** If rent and owners' equivalent rent move sharply, CPI reacts more because shelter has a larger weight.
segments.tr: - **住房驱动的波动。** 如果租金和业主等效租金大幅波动，CPI 的反应会更强烈，因为住房的权重更大。

segments.src: - **Health care and financial services.** A jump in medical prices or portfolio-management fees, which often follow stock-market levels, can lift PCE more than CPI.
segments.tr: - **医疗保健和金融服务。** 医疗价格或投资组合管理费用的跳升（通常跟随股市水平）可能会比 CPI 更大地推高 PCE。

segments.src: - **Revisions.** An updated PCE estimate can shift the picture after the first release.
segments.tr: - **修正。** 更新后的 PCE 估算值可能会在首次发布后改变情况。

segments.src: - **Timing.** CPI is published first each month, and parts of it feed into PCE estimates. Markets often treat CPI and producer price data as a preview of PCE. Those previews are estimates, and the final PCE figure can differ.
segments.tr: - **时间差异。** CPI 每月最先发布，其部分内容会纳入 PCE 估算。市场通常将 CPI 和生产者价格数据视为 PCE 的预演。这些预演只是估算值，最终的 PCE 数据可能会有所不同。

segments.src: ## How to Read the Data
segments.tr: ## 如何解读数据

segments.src: A few habits help when the two measures disagree:
segments.tr: 当两个指标不一致时，养成以下几个习惯会有所帮助：

segments.src: - **Compare like with like.** Check whether you are looking at headline or core figures, and monthly or year-over-year changes.
segments.tr: - **同类比较。** 检查您看的是总体数据还是核心数据，以及是月度变化还是同比变化。

segments.src: - **Look at the drivers.** Find out which categories explain the gap before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: - **观察驱动因素。** 在得出结论之前，找出哪些类别导致了差距。

segments.src: - **Watch the trend, not one release.** A single month can be distorted by one-off factors.
segments.tr: - **关注趋势，而非单次发布。** 单个月份的数据可能会受到一次性因素的扭曲。

segments.src: - **Remember the purpose.** CPI is widely used for inflation-linked adjustments, including Social Security cost-of-living increases. PCE guides monetary policy.
segments.tr: - **记住目的。** CPI 被广泛用于与通胀挂钩的调整，包括社会保障生活成本增加。PCE 则指导货币政策。

segments.src: ## What It Means for the December Meeting
segments.tr: ## 这对 12 月会议意味着什么

segments.src: Policymakers weigh many inputs, including employment, wage growth, inflation expectations and financial conditions.
segments.tr: 政策制定者权衡许多输入因素，包括就业、工资增长、通胀预期和金融状况。

segments.src: PCE inflation, especially the core measure, is central to their assessment of whether prices are returning to the 2% goal.
segments.tr: PCE 通胀，尤其是核心指标，是他们评估物价是否正在回归 2% 目标的核心。

segments.src: When CPI and PCE tell different stories, officials look past the headline numbers and examine the components behind them.
segments.tr: 当 CPI 和 PCE 讲述不同的故事时，官员们会透过头条数字，检查其背后的组成部分。

segments.src: For readers, the takeaway is that neither index is "right" and the other "wrong."
segments.tr: 对于读者来说，结论是这两个指数没有谁“对”谁“错”之分。

segments.src: They measure related but distinct things.
segments.tr: 它们衡量的是相关但不同的事物。

segments.src: Knowing how they differ helps you interpret each new release and understand why the Fed's reading of inflation may not match the figure in the morning headline.
segments.tr: 了解它们的区别有助于您解读每一次新发布的数据，并理解为什么美联储的通胀解读可能与早间头条新闻中的数字不符。

hi.title: PCE बनाम CPI: फेड का पसंदीदा मुद्रास्फीति पैमाना अक्सर अलग कहानी क्यों बयां करता है

segments.src: As the Federal Reserve approaches its December policy meeting, one number gets more attention inside the central bank than almost any other: the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index.
segments.tr: जैसे-जैसे फेडरल रिजर्व अपनी दिसंबर की नीतिगत बैठक के करीब पहुंचता है, केंद्रीय बैंक के भीतर एक आंकड़े पर किसी भी अन्य चीज़ की तुलना में सबसे अधिक ध्यान दिया जाता है: व्यक्तिगत उपभोग व्यय (PCE) मूल्य सूचकांक।

segments.src: Most households know the Consumer Price Index (CPI) better.
segments.tr: अधिकांश घराने उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI) को बेहतर जानते हैं।

segments.src: It drives the headlines, cost-of-living adjustments and everyday conversation about prices.
segments.tr: यह सुर्खियों, जीवन-यापन लागत समायोजन और कीमतों के बारे में दैनिक बातचीत को संचालित करता है।

segments.src: Yet the Fed formally targets PCE inflation, and the two measures can point in different directions.
segments.tr: फिर भी फेड औपचारिक रूप से PCE मुद्रास्फीति को लक्षित करता है, और ये दोनों पैमाने अलग-अलग दिशाओं की ओर इशारा कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: This explainer covers what each index measures, where they differ, and why the gap matters when you read the data.
segments.tr: यह व्याख्यात्मक लेख यह बताता है कि प्रत्येक सूचकांक क्या मापता है, वे कहाँ भिन्न हैं, और जब आप डेटा पढ़ते हैं तो यह अंतर क्यों मायने रखता है।

segments.src: ## Two Gauges, Two Agencies
segments.tr: ## दो पैमाने, दो एजेंसियां

segments.src: **CPI** is produced by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).
segments.tr: **CPI** श्रम सांख्यिकी ब्यूरो (BLS) द्वारा जारी किया जाता है।

segments.src: It tracks the average change in prices that urban consumers pay out of pocket for a fixed basket of goods and services.
segments.tr: यह वस्तुओं और सेवाओं की एक निश्चित टोकरी के लिए शहरी उपभोक्ताओं द्वारा जेब से भुगतान की जाने वाली कीमतों में औसत परिवर्तन पर नज़र रखता है।

segments.src: **PCE** is produced by the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) as part of the national income and product accounts.
segments.tr: **PCE** आर्थिक विश्लेषण ब्यूरो (BEA) द्वारा राष्ट्रीय आय और उत्पाद खातों के हिस्से के रूप में तैयार किया जाता है।

segments.src: It measures price changes for the goods and services consumed by households.
segments.tr: यह घर-परिवारों द्वारा उपभोग की जाने वाली वस्तुओं और सेवाओं के मूल्य परिवर्तनों को मापता है।

segments.src: That includes spending made on their behalf.
segments.tr: इसमें उनकी ओर से किया गया खर्च भी शामिल है।

segments.src: Both aim to answer the question "how fast are prices rising?"
segments.tr: दोनों का उद्देश्य इस प्रश्न का उत्तर देना है कि "कीमतें कितनी तेजी से बढ़ रही हैं?"

segments.src: But they start from different data and answer slightly different versions of the question.
segments.tr: लेकिन वे अलग-अलग डेटा से शुरू होते हैं और इस प्रश्न के थोड़े अलग संस्करणों का उत्तर देते हैं।

segments.src: ## Difference 1: Weights
segments.tr: ## अंतर 1: भारांक (Weights)

segments.src: The most important difference is how much each category counts.
segments.tr: सबसे महत्वपूर्ण अंतर यह है कि प्रत्येक श्रेणी का कितना महत्व है।

segments.src: - **Housing.** Shelter makes up roughly a third of the overall CPI basket. In PCE its share is much smaller, often cited as around 15%. When rents and housing costs are the main driver of inflation, CPI tends to run hotter than PCE. When shelter cools, CPI can fall faster.
segments.tr: - **आवास।** कुल CPI बास्केट में आवास का हिस्सा लगभग एक तिहाई है। PCE में इसका हिस्सा बहुत कम है, जिसे अक्सर लगभग 15% बताया जाता है। जब किराए और आवास की लागत मुद्रास्फीति का मुख्य चालक होती है, तो CPI, PCE की तुलना में अधिक तेजी से बढ़ता है। जब आवास की लागत ठंडी होती है, तो CPI अधिक तेज़ी से गिर सकता है।

segments.src: - **Health care.** PCE gives health care a larger weight. It counts spending by Medicare, Medicaid and employer-provided insurance, not only what consumers pay directly.
segments.tr: - **स्वास्थ्य सेवा।** PCE स्वास्थ्य सेवा को अधिक भारांक देता है। इसमें मेडिकेयर, मेडिकेयड और नियोक्ता-प्रदत्त बीमा द्वारा किए गए खर्च शामिल हैं, केवल वही नहीं जो उपभोक्ता सीधे भुगतान करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Other categories.** Items such as financial services and some services paid for by third parties have a bigger presence in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: - **अन्य श्रेणियां।** वित्तीय सेवाओं और तीसरे पक्ष द्वारा भुगतान की जाने वाली कुछ सेवाओं जैसी मदों की उपस्थिति CPI की तुलना में PCE में अधिक होती है।

segments.src: Because the weights differ, the same price moves can produce different headline numbers.
segments.tr: क्योंकि भारांक अलग-अलग होते हैं, इसलिए समान मूल्य परिवर्तनों से अलग-अलग प्रमुख आंकड़े आ सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Difference 2: Scope
segments.tr: ## अंतर 2: दायरा (Scope)

segments.src: CPI is built from out-of-pocket spending by urban households.
segments.tr: CPI शहरी परिवारों द्वारा जेब से किए गए खर्च से बनाया गया है।

segments.src: PCE covers a broader universe:
segments.tr: PCE एक व्यापक दायरे को कवर करता है:

segments.src: - Spending by all households, including rural ones
segments.tr: - ग्रामीण परिवारों सहित सभी परिवारों द्वारा खर्च

segments.src: - Spending by nonprofit institutions serving households
segments.tr: - परिवारों की सेवा करने वाली गैर-लाभकारी संस्थाओं द्वारा खर्च

segments.src: - Costs paid by third parties, such as government health programs and employer-sponsored insurance
segments.tr: - तीसरे पक्ष द्वारा भुगतान की जाने वाली लागतें, जैसे सरकारी स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रम और नियोक्ता-प्रायोजित बीमा

segments.src: This is why health care looks so different in the two indexes.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि दोनों सूचकांकों में स्वास्थ्य सेवा इतनी अलग दिखती है।

segments.src: A hospital bill paid largely by an insurer shows up more fully in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: बीमाकर्ता द्वारा मुख्य रूप से भुगतान किया गया अस्पताल का बिल CPI की तुलना में PCE में अधिक पूरी तरह से दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: ## Difference 3: Methodology
segments.tr: ## अंतर 3: कार्यप्रणाली (Methodology)

segments.src: The two indexes also differ in how they are calculated.
segments.tr: दोनों सूचकांकों की गणना के तरीके में भी अंतर है।

segments.src: - **Weight updates.** CPI weights come mainly from the Consumer Expenditure Survey and are updated on a set schedule. PCE weights come from broader business and national accounts data and are updated continuously.
segments.tr: - **भारांक अपडेट।** CPI भारांक मुख्य रूप से उपभोक्ता व्यय सर्वेक्षण से आते हैं और एक निश्चित समय-सारणी पर अपडेट किए जाते हैं। PCE भारांक व्यापक व्यावसायिक और राष्ट्रीय खातों के डेटा से आते हैं और लगातार अपडेट किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Formula.** PCE uses a chained, Fisher-type formula that captures how consumers shift between goods when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE reflects that substitution faster. CPI has narrowed this gap over the years, but it still captures substitution less fully.
segments.tr: - **फॉर्मूला।** PCE एक श्रंखलाबद्ध (chained), फिशर-प्रकार के फॉर्मूले का उपयोग करता है जो यह दर्शाता है कि सापेक्ष कीमतों में बदलाव होने पर उपभोक्ता वस्तुओं के बीच कैसे बदलाव करते हैं। यदि बीफ महंगा हो जाता है और खरीदार अधिक चिकन खरीदते हैं, तो PCE उस प्रतिस्थापन को तेज़ी से दर्शाता है। CPI ने वर्षों में इस अंतर को कम किया है, लेकिन यह अभी भी प्रतिस्थापन को पूरी तरह से कैप्चर नहीं करता है।

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is almost never revised after release, apart from seasonal factors. PCE can be revised several times as new source data arrive, sometimes for months or years.
segments.tr: - **संशोधन।** मौसमी कारकों को छोड़कर, जारी होने के बाद CPI को शायद ही कभी संशोधित किया जाता है। नया स्रोत डेटा आने पर PCE को कई बार संशोधित किया जा सकता है, कभी-कभी महीनों या वर्षों के लिए।

segments.src: Together these differences have historically kept CPI inflation a few tenths of a percentage point above PCE inflation on average.
segments.tr: इन अंतरों ने ऐतिहासिक रूप से CPI मुद्रास्फीति को औसतन PCE मुद्रास्फीति से एक प्रतिशत बिंदु के कुछ दसवें हिस्से ऊपर रखा है।

segments.src: The gap is not constant.
segments.tr: यह अंतर स्थिर नहीं है।

segments.src: It can widen or narrow depending on what is driving prices.
segments.tr: कीमतों को क्या संचालित कर रहा है, इसके आधार पर यह चौड़ा या कम हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Prefers PCE
segments.tr: ## फेड PCE को तरजीह क्यों देता है

segments.src: The Fed adopted an explicit 2% inflation goal in 2012, measured by the PCE price index.
segments.tr: फेड ने 2012 में एक स्पष्ट 2% मुद्रास्फीति लक्ष्य को अपनाया, जिसे PCE मूल्य सूचकांक द्वारा मापा जाता है।

segments.src: Policymakers have given several reasons for preferring it:
segments.tr: नीति निर्माताओं ने इसे तरजीह देने के कई कारण दिए हैं:

segments.src: 1. **Broader coverage.** It captures a wider range of consumer spending.
segments.tr: 1. **व्यापक कवरेज।** यह उपभोक्ता खर्च की एक विस्तृत श्रृंखला को कैप्चर करता है।

segments.src: 2. **Better handling of substitution.** The formula adjusts as buying patterns change.
segments.tr: 2. **प्रतिस्थापन का बेहतर प्रबंधन।** खरीद पैटर्न बदलने के साथ फॉर्मूला समायोजित होता है।

segments.src: 3. **Revisability.** Historical data can be corrected as better information becomes available.
segments.tr: 3. **संशोधन की क्षमता।** बेहतर जानकारी उपलब्ध होने पर ऐतिहासिक डेटा को सही किया जा सकता है।

segments.src: Officials also watch **core PCE**, which excludes food and energy.
segments.tr: अधिकारी **कोर PCE** पर भी नज़र रखते हैं, जिसमें भोजन और ऊर्जा शामिल नहीं हैं।

segments.src: These categories are volatile, and core readings are often seen as a cleaner guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: ये श्रेणियां अस्थिर हैं, और कोर रीडिंग को अक्सर अंतर्निहित रुझानों के लिए एक स्पष्ट मार्गदर्शक के रूप में देखा जाता है।

segments.src: Many analysts also follow narrower cuts, such as core services excluding housing.
segments.tr: कई विश्लेषक आवास को छोड़कर कोर सेवाओं जैसे संकीर्ण वर्गों का भी पालन करते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why the Two Can Point in Different Directions
segments.tr: ## दोनों अलग-अलग दिशाओं की ओर इशारा क्यों कर सकते हैं

segments.src: Divergences usually come from a few sources:
segments.tr: विचालन आमतौर पर कुछ स्रोतों से आते हैं:

segments.src: - **A shelter-driven swing.** If rent and owners' equivalent rent move sharply, CPI reacts more because shelter has a larger weight.
segments.tr: - **आवास-संचालित उतार-चढ़ाव।** यदि किराया और मकान मालिकों का समतुल्य किराया तेज़ी से बदलता है, तो CPI अधिक प्रतिक्रिया करता है क्योंकि आवास का भारांक अधिक होता है।

segments.src: - **Health care and financial services.** A jump in medical prices or portfolio-management fees, which often follow stock-market levels, can lift PCE more than CPI.
segments.tr: - **स्वास्थ्य सेवा और वित्तीय सेवाएं।** चिकित्सा कीमतों या पोर्टफोलियो-प्रबंधन शुल्कों में उछाल, जो अक्सर शेयर-बाजार के स्तरों का पालन करते हैं, CPI की तुलना में PCE को अधिक बढ़ा सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Revisions.** An updated PCE estimate can shift the picture after the first release.
segments.tr: - **संशोधन।** एक अद्यतन PCE अनुमान पहली रिलीज़ के बाद स्थिति को बदल सकता है।

segments.src: - **Timing.** CPI is published first each month, and parts of it feed into PCE estimates. Markets often treat CPI and producer price data as a preview of PCE. Those previews are estimates, and the final PCE figure can differ.
segments.tr: - **समय।** CPI हर महीने सबसे पहले प्रकाशित होता है, और इसके कुछ हिस्से PCE अनुमानों में योगदान करते हैं। बाजार अक्सर CPI और उत्पादक मूल्य डेटा को PCE के पूर्वावलोकन के रूप में मानते हैं। वे पूर्वावलोकन अनुमान हैं, और अंतिम PCE आंकड़ा भिन्न हो सकता है।

segments.src: ## How to Read the Data
segments.tr: ## डेटा को कैसे पढ़ें

segments.src: A few habits help when the two measures disagree:
segments.tr: जब दोनों पैमानों में असहमति हो तो कुछ आदतें मदद करती हैं:

segments.src: - **Compare like with like.** Check whether you are looking at headline or core figures, and monthly or year-over-year changes.
segments.tr: - **समान चीज़ों की तुलना करें।** जांचें कि क्या आप हेडलाइन या कोर आंकड़ों को देख रहे हैं, और मासिक या साल-दर-साल बदलावों को देख रहे हैं।

segments.src: - **Look at the drivers.** Find out which categories explain the gap before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: - **चालकों को देखें।** निष्कर्ष निकालने से पहले यह पता लगाएं कि कौन सी श्रेणियां अंतर की व्याख्या करती हैं।

segments.src: - **Watch the trend, not one release.** A single month can be distorted by one-off factors.
segments.tr: - **रुझान देखें, एक रिलीज़ को नहीं।** एक एकल महीना एकमुश्त कारकों से विकृत हो सकता है।

segments.src: - **Remember the purpose.** CPI is widely used for inflation-linked adjustments, including Social Security cost-of-living increases. PCE guides monetary policy.
segments.tr: - **उद्देश्य को याद रखें।** CPI का उपयोग व्यापक रूप से सामाजिक सुरक्षा जीवन-यापन लागत में वृद्धि सहित मुद्रास्फीति-संबद्ध समायोजनों के लिए किया जाता है। PCE मौद्रिक नीति का मार्गदर्शन करता है।

segments.src: ## What It Means for the December Meeting
segments.tr: ## दिसंबर की बैठक के लिए इसका क्या अर्थ है

segments.src: Policymakers weigh many inputs, including employment, wage growth, inflation expectations and financial conditions.
segments.tr: नीति निर्माता रोजगार, वेतन वृद्धि, मुद्रास्फीति की उम्मीदों और वित्तीय स्थितियों सहित कई इनपुट पर विचार करते हैं।

segments.src: PCE inflation, especially the core measure, is central to their assessment of whether prices are returning to the 2% goal.
segments.tr: PCE मुद्रास्फीति, विशेष रूप से कोर माप, उनके इस आकलन के लिए केंद्रीय है कि क्या कीमतें 2% के लक्ष्य पर लौट रही हैं।

segments.src: When CPI and PCE tell different stories, officials look past the headline numbers and examine the components behind them.
segments.tr: जब CPI और PCE अलग-अलग कहानियां बताते हैं, तो अधिकारी मुख्य आंकड़ों से आगे देखते हैं और उनके पीछे के घटकों की जांच करते हैं।

segments.src: For readers, the takeaway is that neither index is "right" and the other "wrong."
segments.tr: पाठकों के लिए निष्कर्ष यह है कि न तो कोई सूचकांक "सही" है और न ही दूसरा "गलत"।

segments.src: They measure related but distinct things.
segments.tr: वे संबंधित लेकिन अलग-अलग चीज़ों को मापते हैं।

segments.src: Knowing how they differ helps you interpret each new release and understand why the Fed's reading of inflation may not match the figure in the morning headline.
segments.tr: यह जानना कि वे कैसे भिन्न हैं, आपको प्रत्येक नई रिलीज़ की व्याख्या करने में मदद करता है और यह समझने में मदद करता है कि मुद्रास्फीति के बारे में फेड का आकलन सुबह की सुर्खियों के आंकड़े से मेल क्यों नहीं खा सकता है।

segments.tr: यह निवेश, वित्तीय या कर सलाह नहीं है।

segments.tr: वर्तमान डेटा और कार्यप्रणाली के लिए BLS और BEA वेबसाइटों की जांच करें।*

es.title: PCE frente a CPI: Por qué el indicador de inflación favorito de la Fed suele contar una historia diferente

segments.src: As the Federal Reserve approaches its December policy meeting, one number gets more attention inside the central bank than almost any other: the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index.
segments.tr: A medida que la Reserva Federal se acerca a su reunión de política monetaria de diciembre, un número recibe más atención dentro del banco central que casi cualquier otro: el índice de precios de los Gastos de Consumo Personal (PCE, por sus siglas en inglés).

segments.src: Most households know the Consumer Price Index (CPI) better.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los hogares conoce mejor el Índice de Precios al Consumidor (CPI).

segments.src: It drives the headlines, cost-of-living adjustments and everyday conversation about prices.
segments.tr: Este impulsa los titulares, los ajustes por costo de vida y las conversaciones cotidianas sobre los precios.

segments.src: Yet the Fed formally targets PCE inflation, and the two measures can point in different directions.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, la Fed fija formalmente su objetivo en la inflación del PCE, y ambas medidas pueden apuntar en direcciones distintas.

segments.src: This explainer covers what each index measures, where they differ, and why the gap matters when you read the data.
segments.tr: Esta guía explica qué mide cada índice, en qué se diferencian y por qué la brecha importa al leer los datos.

segments.src: ## Two Gauges, Two Agencies
segments.tr: ## Dos Indicadores, Dos Agencias

segments.src: **CPI** is produced by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).
segments.tr: El **CPI** es elaborado por la Oficina de Estadísticas Laborales (BLS).

segments.src: It tracks the average change in prices that urban consumers pay out of pocket for a fixed basket of goods and services.
segments.tr: Rastrea el cambio promedio en los precios que los consumidores urbanos pagan de su bolsillo por una cesta fija de bienes y servicios.

segments.src: **PCE** is produced by the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) as part of the national income and product accounts.
segments.tr: El **PCE** es elaborado por la Oficina de Análisis Económico (BEA) como parte de las cuentas nacionales de ingresos y productos.

segments.src: It measures price changes for the goods and services consumed by households.
segments.tr: Mide los cambios de precios de los bienes y servicios consumidos por los hogares.

segments.src: That includes spending made on their behalf.
segments.tr: Eso incluye el gasto realizado en su nombre.

segments.src: Both aim to answer the question "how fast are prices rising?"
segments.tr: Ambos buscan responder a la pregunta "¿qué tan rápido están subiendo los precios?".

segments.src: But they start from different data and answer slightly different versions of the question.
segments.tr: Pero parten de datos diferentes y responden a versiones ligeramente distintas de la pregunta.

segments.src: ## Difference 1: Weights
segments.tr: ## Diferencia 1: Ponderaciones

segments.src: The most important difference is how much each category counts.
segments.tr: La diferencia más importante es cuánto cuenta cada categoría.

segments.src: - **Housing.** Shelter makes up roughly a third of the overall CPI basket. In PCE its share is much smaller, often cited as around 15%. When rents and housing costs are the main driver of inflation, CPI tends to run hotter than PCE. When shelter cools, CPI can fall faster.
segments.tr: - **Vivienda.** El alojamiento representa aproximadamente un tercio de la cesta general del CPI. En el PCE su participación es mucho menor, citándose a menudo en torno al 15%. Cuando los alquileres y los costos de la vivienda son el principal motor de la inflación, el CPI tiende a subir más rápido que el PCE. Cuando el alojamiento se enfría, el CPI puede caer más rápido.

segments.src: - **Health care.** PCE gives health care a larger weight. It counts spending by Medicare, Medicaid and employer-provided insurance, not only what consumers pay directly.
segments.tr: - **Cuidado de la salud.** El PCE le otorga un peso mayor al cuidado de la salud. Cuenta el gasto de Medicare, Medicaid y el seguro proporcionado por el empleador, no solo lo que los consumidores pagan directamente.

segments.src: - **Other categories.** Items such as financial services and some services paid for by third parties have a bigger presence in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: - **Otras categorías.** Artículos como los servicios financieros y algunos servicios pagados por terceros tienen una presencia mayor en el PCE que en el CPI.

segments.src: Because the weights differ, the same price moves can produce different headline numbers.
segments.tr: Debido a que las ponderaciones difieren, los mismos movimientos de precios pueden producir cifras principales diferentes.

segments.src: ## Difference 2: Scope
segments.tr: ## Diferencia 2: Alcance

segments.src: CPI is built from out-of-pocket spending by urban households.
segments.tr: El CPI se construye a partir del gasto de bolsillo de los hogares urbanos.

segments.src: PCE covers a broader universe:
segments.tr: El PCE cubre un universo más amplio:

segments.src: - Spending by all households, including rural ones
segments.tr: - Gasto de todos los hogares, incluidos los rurales

segments.src: - Spending by nonprofit institutions serving households
segments.tr: - Gasto de instituciones sin fines de lucro que sirven a los hogares

segments.src: - Costs paid by third parties, such as government health programs and employer-sponsored insurance
segments.tr: - Costos pagados por terceros, como programas de salud gubernamentales y seguros patrocinados por empleadores

segments.src: This is why health care looks so different in the two indexes.
segments.tr: Por esto el cuidado de la salud se ve tan diferente en los dos índices.

segments.src: A hospital bill paid largely by an insurer shows up more fully in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: Una factura de hospital pagada en gran parte por una aseguradora se refleja de manera más completa en el PCE que en el CPI.

segments.src: ## Difference 3: Methodology
segments.tr: ## Diferencia 3: Metodología

segments.src: The two indexes also differ in how they are calculated.
segments.tr: Los dos índices también difieren en cómo se calculan.

segments.src: - **Weight updates.** CPI weights come mainly from the Consumer Expenditure Survey and are updated on a set schedule. PCE weights come from broader business and national accounts data and are updated continuously.
segments.tr: - **Actualizaciones de ponderación.** Las ponderaciones del CPI provienen principalmente de la Encuesta de Gasto del Consumidor y se actualizan en un calendario establecido. Las ponderaciones del PCE provienen de datos más amplios de negocios y cuentas nacionales y se actualizan continuamente.

segments.src: - **Formula.** PCE uses a chained, Fisher-type formula that captures how consumers shift between goods when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE reflects that substitution faster. CPI has narrowed this gap over the years, but it still captures substitution less fully.
segments.tr: - **Fórmula.** El PCE utiliza una fórmula encadenada de tipo Fisher que capta cómo los consumidores cambian entre bienes cuando los precios relativos varían. Si la carne de res se encarece y los compradores compran más pollo, el PCE refleja esa sustitución más rápido. El CPI ha reducido esta brecha con los años, pero sigue captando la sustitución de forma menos completa.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is almost never revised after release, apart from seasonal factors. PCE can be revised several times as new source data arrive, sometimes for months or years.
segments.tr: - **Revisiones.** El CPI casi nunca se revisa después de su publicación, aparte de los factores estacionales. El PCE puede revisarse varias veces a medida que llegan nuevos datos de origen, a veces durante meses o años.

segments.src: Together these differences have historically kept CPI inflation a few tenths of a percentage point above PCE inflation on average.
segments.tr: Juntas, estas diferencias han mantenido históricamente la inflación del CPI unas pocas décimas de punto porcentual por encima de la inflación del PCE en promedio.

segments.src: The gap is not constant.
segments.tr: La brecha no es constante.

segments.src: It can widen or narrow depending on what is driving prices.
segments.tr: Puede ampliarse o reducirse dependiendo de qué esté impulsando los precios.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Prefers PCE
segments.tr: ## Por qué la Fed Prefiere el PCE

segments.src: The Fed adopted an explicit 2% inflation goal in 2012, measured by the PCE price index.
segments.tr: La Fed adoptó un objetivo de inflación explícito del 2% en 2012, medido por el índice de precios del PCE.

segments.src: Policymakers have given several reasons for preferring it:
segments.tr: Los responsables de las políticas han dado varias razones para preferirlo:

segments.src: 1. **Broader coverage.** It captures a wider range of consumer spending.
segments.tr: 1. **Cobertura más amplia.** Captura un rango más amplio de gasto del consumidor.

segments.src: 2. **Better handling of substitution.** The formula adjusts as buying patterns change.
segments.tr: 2. **Mejor manejo de la sustitución.** La fórmula se ajusta a medida que cambian los patrones de compra.

segments.src: 3. **Revisability.** Historical data can be corrected as better information becomes available.
segments.tr: 3. **Revisibilidad.** Los datos históricos se pueden corregir a medida que se dispone de mejor información.

segments.src: Officials also watch **core PCE**, which excludes food and energy.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios también vigilan el **PCE subyacente (core PCE)**, que excluye alimentos y energía.

segments.src: These categories are volatile, and core readings are often seen as a cleaner guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: Estas categorías son volátiles y las lecturas subyacentes a menudo se consideran una guía más limpia de las tendencias subyacentes.

segments.src: Many analysts also follow narrower cuts, such as core services excluding housing.
segments.tr: Muchos analistas también siguen cortes más estrechos, como los servicios subyacentes excluyendo la vivienda.

segments.src: ## Why the Two Can Point in Different Directions
segments.tr: ## Por qué los Dos Pueden Apuntar en Direcciones Diferentes

segments.src: Divergences usually come from a few sources:
segments.tr: Las divergencias suelen provenir de unas pocas fuentes:

segments.src: - **A shelter-driven swing.** If rent and owners' equivalent rent move sharply, CPI reacts more because shelter has a larger weight.
segments.tr: - **Un giro impulsado por el alojamiento.** Si el alquiler y el equivalente de alquiler de los propietarios se mueven drásticamente, el CPI reacciona más porque el alojamiento tiene un peso mayor.

segments.src: - **Health care and financial services.** A jump in medical prices or portfolio-management fees, which often follow stock-market levels, can lift PCE more than CPI.
segments.tr: - **Cuidado de la salud y servicios financieros.** Un salto en los precios médicos o en las comisiones de gestión de carteras, que a menudo siguen los niveles del mercado bursátil, puede elevar el PCE más que el CPI.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** An updated PCE estimate can shift the picture after the first release.
segments.tr: - **Revisiones.** Una estimación actualizada del PCE puede cambiar el panorama después de la primera publicación.

segments.src: - **Timing.** CPI is published first each month, and parts of it feed into PCE estimates. Markets often treat CPI and producer price data as a preview of PCE. Those previews are estimates, and the final PCE figure can differ.
segments.tr: - **Cronograma.** El CPI se publica primero cada mes, y partes de él se alimentan en las estimaciones del PCE. Los mercados a menudo tratan los datos del CPI y de precios al productor como un adelanto del PCE. Esos adelantos son estimaciones, y la cifra final del PCE puede diferir.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Data
segments.tr: ## Cómo Leer los Datos

segments.src: A few habits help when the two measures disagree:
segments.tr: Algunos hábitos ayudan cuando las dos medidas discrepan:

segments.src: - **Compare like with like.** Check whether you are looking at headline or core figures, and monthly or year-over-year changes.
segments.tr: - **Comparar lo comparable.** Compruebe si está observando cifras principales o subyacentes, y cambios mensuales o interanuales.

segments.src: - **Look at the drivers.** Find out which categories explain the gap before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: - **Observar los impulsores.** Averigüe qué categorías explican la brecha antes de sacar conclusiones.

segments.src: - **Watch the trend, not one release.** A single month can be distorted by one-off factors.
segments.tr: - **Vigilar la tendencia, no una sola publicación.** Un solo mes puede estar distorsionado por factores únicos.

segments.src: - **Remember the purpose.** CPI is widely used for inflation-linked adjustments, including Social Security cost-of-living increases. PCE guides monetary policy.
segments.tr: - **Recordar el propósito.** El CPI se utiliza ampliamente para ajustes vinculados a la inflación, incluidos los aumentos por costo de vida del Seguro Social. El PCE guía la política monetaria.

segments.src: ## What It Means for the December Meeting
segments.tr: ## Qué Significa para la Reunión de Diciembre

segments.src: Policymakers weigh many inputs, including employment, wage growth, inflation expectations and financial conditions.
segments.tr: Los responsables de las políticas sopesan muchos factores, incluidos el empleo, el crecimiento salarial, las expectativas de inflación y las condiciones financieras.

segments.src: PCE inflation, especially the core measure, is central to their assessment of whether prices are returning to the 2% goal.
segments.tr: La inflación del PCE, especialmente la medida subyacente, es fundamental para su evaluación de si los precios están regresando al objetivo del 2%.

segments.src: When CPI and PCE tell different stories, officials look past the headline numbers and examine the components behind them.
segments.tr: Cuando el CPI y el PCE cuentan historias diferentes, los funcionarios miran más allá de las cifras principales y examinan los componentes detrás de ellas.

segments.src: For readers, the takeaway is that neither index is "right" and the other "wrong."
segments.tr: Para los lectores, la conclusión es que ningún índice es "correcto" y el otro "incorrecto".

segments.src: They measure related but distinct things.
segments.tr: Miden cosas relacionadas pero distintas.

segments.src: Knowing how they differ helps you interpret each new release and understand why the Fed's reading of inflation may not match the figure in the morning headline.
segments.tr: Saber en qué se diferencian le ayuda a interpretar cada nueva publicación y a entender por qué la lectura de la inflación por parte de la Fed puede no coincidir con la cifra del titular matutino.

ar.title: PCE مقابل CPI: لماذا تروي المقياس المفضل للبنك الفيدرالي للتضخم قصة مختلفة غالبًا

segments.src: As the Federal Reserve approaches its December policy meeting, one number gets more attention inside the central bank than almost any other: the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index.
segments.tr: مع اقتراب الاحتياطي الفيدرالي من اجتماعه السياساتي في ديسمبر، يحظى رقم واحد باهتمام داخل البنك المركزي أكثر من أي رقم آخر تقريبًا: مؤشر أسعار نفقات الاستهلاك الشخصي (PCE).

segments.src: Most households know the Consumer Price Index (CPI) better.
segments.tr: تعرف معظم الأسر مؤشر أسعار المستهلك (CPI) بشكل أفضل.

segments.src: It drives the headlines, cost-of-living adjustments and everyday conversation about prices.
segments.tr: فهو يتصدر العناوين الرئيسية، وتعديلات تكلفة المعيشة، والمحادثات اليومية حول الأسعار.

segments.src: Yet the Fed formally targets PCE inflation, and the two measures can point in different directions.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، يستهدف الفيدرالي رسميًا تضخم PCE، ويمكن للمقياسين أن يشيرا إلى اتجاهين مختلفين.

segments.src: This explainer covers what each index measures, where they differ, and why the gap matters when you read the data.
segments.tr: يغطي هذا المقال التوضيحي ما يقيسه كل مؤشر، وأين يختلفان، ولماذا تهم الفجوة عندما تقرأ البيانات.

segments.src: ## Two Gauges, Two Agencies
segments.tr: ## مقياسان، وكالتان

segments.src: **CPI** is produced by the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS).
segments.tr: يصدر **CPI** عن مكتب إحصاءات العمل (BLS).

segments.src: It tracks the average change in prices that urban consumers pay out of pocket for a fixed basket of goods and services.
segments.tr: وهو يتتبع متوسط التغير في الأسعار التي يدفعها المستهلكون في الحضر من جيبهم الخاص لسلة ثابتة من السلع والخدمات.

segments.src: **PCE** is produced by the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) as part of the national income and product accounts.
segments.tr: يصدر **PCE** عن مكتب التحليل الاقتصادي (BEA) كجزء من حسابات الدخل والمنتج القومي.

segments.src: It measures price changes for the goods and services consumed by households.
segments.tr: وهو يقيس التغيرات في أسعار السلع والخدمات التي تستهلكها الأسر.

segments.src: That includes spending made on their behalf.
segments.tr: ويتضمن ذلك الإنفاق الذي يتم نيابة عنهم.

segments.src: Both aim to answer the question "how fast are prices rising?"
segments.tr: يهدف كلا المؤشرين إلى الإجابة عن سؤال "ما مدى سرعة ارتفاع الأسعار؟"

segments.src: But they start from different data and answer slightly different versions of the question.
segments.tr: لكنهما يبدأن من بيانات مختلفة ويجيبان عن صيغ مختلفة قليلاً من السؤال.

segments.src: ## Difference 1: Weights
segments.tr: ## الاختلاف 1: الأوزان

segments.src: The most important difference is how much each category counts.
segments.tr: الاختلاف الأكثر أهمية هو الوزن الذي تحظى به كل فئة.

segments.src: - **Housing.** Shelter makes up roughly a third of the overall CPI basket. In PCE its share is much smaller, often cited as around 15%. When rents and housing costs are the main driver of inflation, CPI tends to run hotter than PCE. When shelter cools, CPI can fall faster.
segments.tr: - **المأوى.** يشكل المأوى ما يقرب من ثلث إجمالي سلة CPI. وفي PCE تكون حصته أصغر بكثير، وغالبًا ما تُذكر بأنها حوالي 15%. عندما تكون الإيجارات وتكاليف السكن هي المحرك الرئيسي للتضخم، يميل CPI إلى الارتفاع بشكل أكبر من PCE. وعندما يبرد المأوى، يمكن لـ CPI أن ينخفض بسرعة أكبر.

segments.src: - **Health care.** PCE gives health care a larger weight. It counts spending by Medicare, Medicaid and employer-provided insurance, not only what consumers pay directly.
segments.tr: - **الرعاية الصحية.** يعطي PCE الرعاية الصحية وزنًا أكبر. فهو يحسب الإنفاق من قبل برنامج Medicare وMedicaid والتأمين المقدم من أصحاب العمل، وليس فقط ما يدفعه المستهلكون مباشرة.

segments.src: - **Other categories.** Items such as financial services and some services paid for by third parties have a bigger presence in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: - **فئات أخرى.** العناصر مثل الخدمات المالية وبعض الخدمات التي تدفع ثمنها أطراف ثالثة لها حضور أكبر في PCE مقارنة بـ CPI.

segments.src: Because the weights differ, the same price moves can produce different headline numbers.
segments.tr: نظرًا لاختلاف الأوزان، يمكن لنفس تحركات الأسعار أن تنتج أرقامًا رئيسية مختلفة.

segments.src: ## Difference 2: Scope
segments.tr: ## الاختلاف 2: النطاق

segments.src: CPI is built from out-of-pocket spending by urban households.
segments.tr: يتم بناء CPI من الإنفاق المباشر للأسر في الحضر.

segments.src: PCE covers a broader universe:
segments.tr: يغطي PCE نطاقًا أوسع:

segments.src: - Spending by all households, including rural ones
segments.tr: - الإنفاق من قبل جميع الأسر، بما في ذلك الأسر الريفية

segments.src: - Spending by nonprofit institutions serving households
segments.tr: - الإنفاق من قبل المؤسسات غير الربحية التي تخدم الأسر

segments.src: - Costs paid by third parties, such as government health programs and employer-sponsored insurance
segments.tr: - التكاليف التي تدفعها أطراف ثالثة، مثل البرامج الصحية الحكومية والتأمين الممول من أصحاب العمل

segments.src: This is why health care looks so different in the two indexes.
segments.tr: هذا هو السبب في أن الرعاية الصحية تبدو مختلفة تمامًا في المؤشرين.

segments.src: A hospital bill paid largely by an insurer shows up more fully in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: ففاتورة المستشفى التي تدفعها شركة التأمين بشكل كبير تظهر بشكل أوسع في PCE مقارنة بـ CPI.

segments.src: ## Difference 3: Methodology
segments.tr: ## الاختلاف 3: المنهجية

segments.src: The two indexes also differ in how they are calculated.
segments.tr: يختلف المؤشران أيضًا في كيفية حسابها.

segments.src: - **Weight updates.** CPI weights come mainly from the Consumer Expenditure Survey and are updated on a set schedule. PCE weights come from broader business and national accounts data and are updated continuously.
segments.tr: - **تحديثات الأوزان.** تأتي أوزان CPI بشكل رئيسي من مسح إحصاءات أنفاق المستهلك ويتم تحديثها وفق جدول زمني محدد. بينما تأتي أوزان PCE من بيانات تجارية وحسابات قومية أوسع وتحديث باستمرار.

segments.src: - **Formula.** PCE uses a chained, Fisher-type formula that captures how consumers shift between goods when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE reflects that substitution faster. CPI has narrowed this gap over the years, but it still captures substitution less fully.
segments.tr: - **الصيغة.** يستخدم PCE صيغة سلسلة من نوع Fisher التي تلتقط كيفية تحول المستهلكين بين السلع عندما تتغير الأسعار النسبية. إذا أصبح لحم البقر مكلفًا واشترى المتسوقون المزيد من الدجاج، فإن PCE يعكس هذا الاستبدال بسرعة أكبر. وقد ضيق CPI هذه الفجوة على مر السنين، ولكنه لا يزال يلتقط الاستبدال بشكل أقل شمولاً.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is almost never revised after release, apart from seasonal factors. PCE can be revised several times as new source data arrive, sometimes for months or years.
segments.tr: - **المراجعات.** لا يتم تعديل CPI تقريبًا بعد إصداره، باستثناء العوامل الموسمية. بينما يمكن تعديل PCE عدة مرات مع وصول بيانات مصدر جديدة، وأحيانًا لأشهر أو سنوات.

segments.src: Together these differences have historically kept CPI inflation a few tenths of a percentage point above PCE inflation on average.
segments.tr: معًا، أبقت هذه الاختلافات تاريخيًا تضخم CPI أعلى بضعة أعشار من النقطة المئوية من تضخم PCE في المتوسط.

segments.src: The gap is not constant.
segments.tr: الفجوة ليست ثابتة.

segments.src: It can widen or narrow depending on what is driving prices.
segments.tr: يمكن أن تتسع أو تضيق اعتمادًا على ما يحرك الأسعار.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Prefers PCE
segments.tr: ## لماذا يفضل الفيدرالي PCE

segments.src: The Fed adopted an explicit 2% inflation goal in 2012, measured by the PCE price index.
segments.tr: تبنى الفيدرالي هدفًا صريحًا للتضخم بنسبة 2% في عام 2012، مقاسًا بمؤشر أسعار PCE.

segments.src: Policymakers have given several reasons for preferring it:
segments.tr: وقد قدم صانعو السياسات عدة أسباب لتفضيله:

segments.src: 1. **Broader coverage.** It captures a wider range of consumer spending.
segments.tr: 1. **تغطية أوسع.** فهو يلتقط نطاقًا أوسع من إنفاق المستهلكين.

segments.src: 2. **Better handling of substitution.** The formula adjusts as buying patterns change.
segments.tr: 2. **تعامل أفضل مع الاستبدال.** تتكيف الصيغة مع تغير أنماط الشراء.

segments.src: 3. **Revisability.** Historical data can be corrected as better information becomes available.
segments.tr: 3. **قابلة المراجعة.** يمكن تصحيح البيانات التاريخية مع توفر معلومات أفضل.

segments.src: Officials also watch **core PCE**, which excludes food and energy.
segments.tr: يراقب المسؤولون أيضًا **PCE الأساسي**، الذي يستثني الغذاء والطاقة.

segments.src: These categories are volatile, and core readings are often seen as a cleaner guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: هذه الفئات متقلبة، وغالبًا ما تُعتبر القراءات الأساسية دليلاً أكثر وضوحًا للاتجاهات الضمنية.

segments.src: Many analysts also follow narrower cuts, such as core services excluding housing.
segments.tr: كما يتابع العديد من المحللين قطاعات أضيق، مثل الخدمات الأساسية باستثناء السكن.

segments.src: ## Why the Two Can Point in Different Directions
segments.tr: ## لماذا يمكن أن يشيرا إلى اتجاهين مختلفين

segments.src: Divergences usually come from a few sources:
segments.tr: تأتي الاختلافات عادةً من عدة مصادر:

segments.src: - **A shelter-driven swing.** If rent and owners' equivalent rent move sharply, CPI reacts more because shelter has a larger weight.
segments.tr: - **تأرجح مدفوع بالمأوى.** إذا تحرك الإيجار والإيجار المكافئ للمالكين بشكل حاد، يتفاعل CPI بشكل أكبر لأن المأوى له وزن أكبر.

segments.src: - **Health care and financial services.** A jump in medical prices or portfolio-management fees, which often follow stock-market levels, can lift PCE more than CPI.
segments.tr: - **الرعاية الصحية والخدمات المالية.** قفزة في الأسعار الطبية أو رسوم إدارة المحافظ، والتي غالبًا ما تتبع مستويات سوق الأسهم، يمكن أن ترفع PCE أكثر من CPI.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** An updated PCE estimate can shift the picture after the first release.
segments.tr: - **المراجعات.** يمكن لتقدير PCE المحدث أن يغير الصورة بعد الإصدار الأول.

segments.src: - **Timing.** CPI is published first each month, and parts of it feed into PCE estimates. Markets often treat CPI and producer price data as a preview of PCE. Those previews are estimates, and the final PCE figure can differ.
segments.tr: - **التوقيت.** يُنشر CPI أولاً كل شهر، وتغذي أجزاء منه تقديرات PCE. غالبًا ما تتعامل الأسواق مع CPI وبيانات أسعار المنتجين كمعاينة لـ PCE. هذه المعاينات هي تقديرات، ويمكن أن يختلف الرقم النهائي لـ PCE.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Data
segments.tr: ## كيفية قراءة البيانات

segments.src: A few habits help when the two measures disagree:
segments.tr: تساعد بعض العادات عندما يختلف المقياسان:

segments.src: - **Compare like with like.** Check whether you are looking at headline or core figures, and monthly or year-over-year changes.
segments.tr: - **قارن المثل بالمثل.** تحقق مما إذا كنت تنظر إلى الأرقام الرئيسية أو الأساسية، والتغيرات الشهرية أو السنوية.

segments.src: - **Look at the drivers.** Find out which categories explain the gap before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: - **انظر إلى المحركات.** اكتشف الفئات التي تفسر الفجوة قبل استخلاص النتائج.

segments.src: - **Watch the trend, not one release.** A single month can be distorted by one-off factors.
segments.tr: - **راقب الاتجاه، وليس إصدارًا واحدًا.** يمكن لشهر واحد أن يتشوه بفعل عوامل لمرة واحدة.

segments.src: - **Remember the purpose.** CPI is widely used for inflation-linked adjustments, including Social Security cost-of-living increases. PCE guides monetary policy.
segments.tr: - **تذكر الغرض.** يُستخدم CPI على نطاق واسع لتعديلات المرتبطة بالتضخم، بما في ذلك زيادات تكلفة المعيشة للضمان الاجتماعي. بينما يوجه PCE السياسة النقدية.

segments.src: ## What It Means for the December Meeting
segments.tr: ## ماذا يعني ذلك لاجتماع ديسمبر

segments.src: Policymakers weigh many inputs, including employment, wage growth, inflation expectations and financial conditions.
segments.tr: يزن صانعو السياسات العديد من المدخلات، بما في ذلك التوظيف، ونمو الأجور، وتوقعات التضخم، والظروف المالية.

segments.src: PCE inflation, especially the core measure, is central to their assessment of whether prices are returning to the 2% goal.
segments.tr: تضخم PCE، وخاصة المقياس الأساسي، محوري في تقييمهم لما إذا كانت الأسعار تعود إلى هدف 2%.

segments.src: It tracks the average change in prices that urban consumers pay out of pocket for a fixed basket of goods and services.
segments.tr: Il suit l'évolution moyenne des prix que les consommateurs urbains paient de leur poche pour un panier fixe de biens et de services.

segments.src: **PCE** is produced by the Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) as part of the national income and product accounts.
segments.tr: **Le PCE** est produit par le Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) dans le cadre des comptes de revenu et de produit nationaux.

segments.src: It measures price changes for the goods and services consumed by households.
segments.tr: Il mesure les variations de prix des biens et services consommés par les ménages.

segments.src: That includes spending made on their behalf.
segments.tr: Cela inclut les dépenses effectuées en leur nom.

segments.src: Both aim to answer the question "how fast are prices rising?"
segments.tr: Tous deux visent à répondre à la question : « à quelle vitesse les prix augmentent-ils ? »

segments.src: But they start from different data and answer slightly different versions of the question.
segments.tr: Mais ils partent de données différentes et répondent à des versions légèrement différentes de la question.

segments.src: ## Difference 1: Weights
segments.tr: ## Différence 1 : Les pondérations

segments.src: The most important difference is how much each category counts.
segments.tr: La différence la plus importante est le poids de chaque catégorie.

segments.src: - **Housing.** Shelter makes up roughly a third of the overall CPI basket. In PCE its share is much smaller, often cited as around 15%. When rents and housing costs are the main driver of inflation, CPI tends to run hotter than PCE. When shelter cools, CPI can fall faster.
segments.tr: - **Logement.** Le logement représente environ un tiers du panier global du CPI. Dans le PCE, sa part est beaucoup plus faible, souvent citée autour de 15 %. Lorsque les loyers et les coûts du logement sont le principal moteur de l'inflation, le CPI a tendance à être plus élevé que le PCE. Lorsque le logement se calme, le CPI peut chuter plus rapidement.

segments.src: - **Health care.** PCE gives health care a larger weight. It counts spending by Medicare, Medicaid and employer-provided insurance, not only what consumers pay directly.
segments.tr: - **Santé.** Le PCE accorde un poids plus important à la santé. Il comptabilise les dépenses de Medicare, Medicaid et de l'assurance fournie par les employeurs, et pas seulement ce que les consommateurs paient directement.

segments.src: - **Other categories.** Items such as financial services and some services paid for by third parties have a bigger presence in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: - **Autres catégories.** Des éléments tels que les services financiers et certains services payés par des tiers ont une plus grande présence dans le PCE que dans le CPI.

segments.src: Because the weights differ, the same price moves can produce different headline numbers.
segments.tr: En raison de la différence des pondérations, les mêmes mouvements de prix peuvent produire des chiffres globaux différents.

segments.src: ## Difference 2: Scope
segments.tr: ## Différence 2 : Le champ d'application

segments.src: CPI is built from out-of-pocket spending by urban households.
segments.tr: Le CPI est construit à partir des dépenses directes des ménages urbains.

segments.src: PCE covers a broader universe:
segments.tr: Le PCE couvre un univers plus large :

segments.src: - Spending by all households, including rural ones
segments.tr: - Les dépenses de tous les ménages, y compris ruraux

segments.src: - Spending by nonprofit institutions serving households
segments.tr: - Les dépenses des institutions sans but lucratif au service des ménages

segments.src: - Costs paid by third parties, such as government health programs and employer-sponsored insurance
segments.tr: - Les coûts payés par des tiers, tels que les programmes de santé gouvernementaux et l'assurance parrainée par l'employeur

segments.src: This is why health care looks so different in the two indexes.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi la santé apparaît si différemment dans les deux indices.

segments.src: A hospital bill paid largely by an insurer shows up more fully in PCE than in CPI.
segments.tr: Une facture d'hôpital payée en grande partie par un assureur apparaît plus pleinement dans le PCE que dans le CPI.

segments.src: ## Difference 3: Methodology
segments.tr: ## Différence 3 : La méthodologie

segments.src: The two indexes also differ in how they are calculated.
segments.tr: Les deux indices diffèrent également dans la manière dont ils sont calculés.

segments.src: - **Weight updates.** CPI weights come mainly from the Consumer Expenditure Survey and are updated on a set schedule. PCE weights come from broader business and national accounts data and are updated continuously.
segments.tr: - **Mises à jour des pondérations.** Les pondérations du CPI proviennent principalement de l'enquête sur les dépenses de consommation et sont mises à jour selon un calendrier fixe. Les pondérations du PCE proviennent de données d'entreprises et de comptes nationaux plus larges et sont mises à jour en continu.

segments.src: - **Formula.** PCE uses a chained, Fisher-type formula that captures how consumers shift between goods when relative prices change. If beef gets expensive and shoppers buy more chicken, PCE reflects that substitution faster. CPI has narrowed this gap over the years, but it still captures substitution less fully.
segments.tr: - **Formule.** Le PCE utilise une formule chaînée de type Fisher qui capture la façon dont les consommateurs se tournent vers d'autres biens lorsque les prix relatifs changent. Si le bœuf devient cher et que les acheteurs achètent plus de poulet, le PCE reflète cette substitution plus rapidement. Le CPI a réduit cet écart au fil des ans, mais il capture toujours la substitution de manière moins complète.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** CPI is almost never revised after release, apart from seasonal factors. PCE can be revised several times as new source data arrive, sometimes for months or years.
segments.tr: - **Révisions.** Le CPI n'est presque jamais révisé après sa publication, hormis pour les facteurs saisonniers. Le PCE peut être révisé plusieurs fois à mesure que de nouvelles données sources arrivent, parfois pendant des mois ou des années.

segments.src: Together these differences have historically kept CPI inflation a few tenths of a percentage point above PCE inflation on average.
segments.tr: Ensemble, ces différences ont historiquement maintenu l'inflation du CPI quelques dixièmes de point de pourcentage au-dessus de l'inflation du PCE en moyenne.

segments.src: The gap is not constant.
segments.tr: L'écart n'est pas constant.

segments.src: It can widen or narrow depending on what is driving prices.
segments.tr: Il peut s'élargir ou se réduire selon ce qui motive les prix.

segments.src: ## Why the Fed Prefers PCE
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la Fed préfère le PCE

segments.src: The Fed adopted an explicit 2% inflation goal in 2012, measured by the PCE price index.
segments.tr: La Fed a adopté un objectif d'inflation explicite de 2 % en 2012, mesuré par l'indice des prix PCE.

segments.src: Policymakers have given several reasons for preferring it:
segments.tr: Les décideurs politiques ont avancé plusieurs raisons pour le préférer :

segments.src: 1. **Broader coverage.** It captures a wider range of consumer spending.
segments.tr: 1. **Couverture plus large.** Il englobe un éventail plus large de dépenses de consommation.

segments.src: 2. **Better handling of substitution.** The formula adjusts as buying patterns change.
segments.tr: 2. **Meilleure gestion de la substitution.** La formule s'ajuste à mesure que les habitudes d'achat changent.

segments.src: 3. **Revisability.** Historical data can be corrected as better information becomes available.
segments.tr: 3. **Révisibilité.** Les données historiques peuvent être corrigées à mesure que de meilleures informations deviennent disponibles.

segments.src: Officials also watch **core PCE**, which excludes food and energy.
segments.tr: Les responsables surveillent également le **PCE core** (sous-jacent), qui exclut l'alimentation et l'énergie.

segments.src: These categories are volatile, and core readings are often seen as a cleaner guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: Ces catégories sont volatiles, et les lectures sous-jacentes sont souvent considérées comme un guide plus clair des tendances de fond.

segments.src: Many analysts also follow narrower cuts, such as core services excluding housing.
segments.tr: De nombreux analystes suivent également des coupes plus étroites, telles que les services sous-jacents hors logement.

segments.src: ## Why the Two Can Point in Different Directions
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les deux peuvent pointer dans des directions différentes

segments.src: Divergences usually come from a few sources:
segments.tr: Les divergences proviennent généralement de quelques sources :

segments.src: - **A shelter-driven swing.** If rent and owners' equivalent rent move sharply, CPI reacts more because shelter has a larger weight.
segments.tr: - **Une fluctuation liée au logement.** Si le loyer et le loyer imputé aux propriétaires bougent fortement, le CPI réagit davantage parce que le logement a un poids plus important.

segments.src: - **Health care and financial services.** A jump in medical prices or portfolio-management fees, which often follow stock-market levels, can lift PCE more than CPI.
segments.tr: - **La santé et les services financiers.** Un bond des prix médicaux ou des frais de gestion de portefeuille, qui suivent souvent les niveaux boursiers, peut faire monter le PCE plus que le CPI.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** An updated PCE estimate can shift the picture after the first release.
segments.tr: - **Les révisions.** Une estimation actualisée du PCE peut modifier la perspective après la première publication.

segments.src: - **Timing.** CPI is published first each month, and parts of it feed into PCE estimates. Markets often treat CPI and producer price data as a preview of PCE. Those previews are estimates, and the final PCE figure can differ.
segments.tr: - **Le calendrier.** Le CPI est publié en premier chaque mois, et certaines de ses parties alimentent les estimations du PCE. Les marchés traitent souvent le CPI et les données des prix à la production comme un aperçu du PCE. Ces aperçus sont des estimations, et le chiffre final du PCE peut différer.

segments.src: ## How to Read the Data
segments.tr: ## Comment lire les données

segments.src: A few habits help when the two measures disagree:
segments.tr: Quelques habitudes aident lorsque les deux mesures sont en désaccord :

segments.src: - **Compare like with like.** Check whether you are looking at headline or core figures, and monthly or year-over-year changes.
segments.tr: - **Comparer ce qui est comparable.** Vérifiez si vous examinez des chiffres globaux ou sous-jacents, et des variations mensuelles ou d'une année sur l'autre.

segments.src: - **Look at the drivers.** Find out which categories explain the gap before drawing conclusions.
segments.tr: - **Regarder les moteurs.** Découvrez quelles catégories expliquent l'écart avant de tirer des conclusions.

segments.src: - **Watch the trend, not one release.** A single month can be distorted by one-off factors.
segments.tr: - **Surveiller la tendance, pas une seule publication.** Un seul mois peut être faussé par des facteurs ponctuels.

segments.src: - **Remember the purpose.** CPI is widely used for inflation-linked adjustments, including Social Security cost-of-living increases. PCE guides monetary policy.
segments.tr: - **Se souvenir de l'objectif.** Le CPI est largement utilisé pour les ajustements liés à l'inflation, y compris les augmentations du coût de la vie de la Sécurité sociale. Le PCE guide la politique monétaire.

segments.src: ## What It Means for the December Meeting
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour la réunion de décembre

segments.src: Policymakers weigh many inputs, including employment, wage growth, inflation expectations and financial conditions.
segments.tr: Les décideurs pèsent de nombreux intrants, notamment l'emploi, la croissance des salaires, les attentes en matière d'inflation et les conditions financières.

segments.src: PCE inflation, especially the core measure, is central to their assessment of whether prices are returning to the 2% goal.
segments.tr: L'inflation PCE, en particulier la mesure sous-jacente, est centrale dans leur évaluation pour savoir si les prix reviennent vers l'objectif de 2 %.

segments.src: When CPI and PCE tell different stories, officials look past the headline numbers and examine the components behind them.
segments.tr: Lorsque le CPI et le PCE racontent des histoires différentes, les responsables regardent au-delà des chiffres globaux et examinent les composants sous-jacents.

segments.src: For readers, the takeaway is that neither index is "right" and the other "wrong."
segments.tr: Pour les lecteurs, la conclusion est qu'aucun des indices n'est « bon » et l'autre « mauvais ».

segments.src: They measure related but distinct things.
segments.tr: Ils mesurent des choses liées mais distinctes.

segments.src: Knowing how they differ helps you interpret each new release and understand why the Fed's reading of inflation may not match the figure in the morning headline.
segments.tr: Savoir en quoi ils diffèrent vous aide à interpréter chaque nouvelle publication et à comprendre pourquoi la lecture de l'inflation par la Fed peut ne pas correspondre au chiffre du gros titre du matin.
